mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals weakening consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.5% indicates robust economic expansion, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns during the late-cycle expansion phase over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a further increase in unemployment signals deepening economic distress, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
